verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents a model catalog on public endpoints and a guide for choosing open-source models. A Qwen model (qwen-3.8-27b) is explicitly listed on the 'Public shared tier', and a community user confirms Qwen 3.8 27B is hosted. The breadth of the catalog across the named families is not shown. Missing for 10: an enumerated catalog showing Llama, DeepSeek and GPT-OSS on shared endpoints, evidence of breadth or currency across families, and independent corroboration beyond Qwen.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose among a broad catalog of current open-weight model families (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, GPT-OSS and peers) on shared serverless endpoints

citations.quote: Browse all models available on Cerebras public endpoints.
